title: An $n^2\log\log n$ Lower Bound for Permanent Circuits with Valid Division
summary: We record lower bounds for permanent circuits with valid division over characteristic zero, counting nonscalar multiplications and divisions while additions and scalar operations are free. Chapter 5 of OpenAI's Ten Advances supplies the block construction and critical-locus estimate; these, with the parameter choice made here and the classical bounds of Strassen and Baur-Strassen, give liminf as n tends to infinity of L_div(per_n)/(n^2 log_2 log_2 n) >= 1/12.
